reason: The dealt triptych hero's own recipe (layout.css) sets its large 64px buttons; the nav and close keep the standard 44px height.
footer--statement is the kit's inset slab (system.css insets it and pads its content); the logo sits on that slab's own wrap.
The kit's own diagram.js starts its pulse loop when the diagram is in view (to save CPU) and loops after that; nothing is hidden or revealed, the nodes are drawn at rest before it starts.

The live section is the product's own UI (the app-frame with the rescue history and the loan) at two screens; its window is sized for the live rescue list, which fills it as rescues arrive, and one screen would cut the window.
